about.title: About ETAX Ho Chi Minh
about.intro: As Vietnam integrates deeper into the global economy, its legal system continues to improve with policies attracting both domestic and foreign investment. To protect investors and ensure their business strategies are backed by a solid legal framework, ETAX Ho Chi Minh's team of experts in economics, finance, accounting, investment, law, and IT are rigorously trained at prestigious institutions with extensive practical experience.
about.mission: At ETAX Ho Chi Minh, clients can rest assured of service quality and work efficiency. We provide comprehensive solutions from legal services, tax, accounting, HR to investment consulting and project management for FDI enterprises and Vietnamese businesses.
about.education_title: A team shaped by leading business and legal institutions
about.education_intro: Our specialists are trained and professionally guided through respected academic environments in Ho Chi Minh City, bringing a balanced view of law, finance, governance, and operations.

list.title: Legal Services & Company Formation
list.short_desc: Full support for establishing, changing, suspending, or dissolving companies for both Vietnamese and foreign-invested enterprises. Covers LLCs, Joint Stock Companies, and Partnerships.
list.full_content:
Service Details

With experience serving hundreds of clients, ETAX Ho Chi Minh guarantees timely delivery, high-quality advice, and dedicated service.

  • Advising on the most suitable investment form and company type
  • Investment incentive procedures: tax exemptions/reductions, land rent exemptions
  • Preparing formation documents, feasibility studies, and company charters
  • Handling changes to business registration (address, capital, business lines, legal representative)
  • Advising on temporary suspension and dissolution in accordance with the law
  • Initial tax registration support, digital signature purchase, and affordable invoice printing

Special Offer: Free tax filing in the first month after establishment.

list.title: Specialized Tax Advisory
list.short_desc: Expert advice on VAT, CIT, PIT policies, tax refunds, exemptions, and reductions. We handle filing, finalization, and represent you before tax authorities. Always up-to-date with new regulations.
list.full_content:
Service Details

ETAX Ho Chi Minh helps businesses avoid tax risks and make accurate business decisions.

  • Initial tax registration procedures and sector-specific tax policy advice
  • Advice on CIT and import duty incentives/exemptions/reductions
  • Representation for VAT, CIT, and PIT filing and finalization
  • Preparation of VAT refund and tax exemption/reduction dossiers
  • Review of legitimate deductible expenses for taxable income calculation
  • Explanation and tax settlement with inspection authorities
  • Rapid updates on new tax regulations

list.title: Accounting & Tax Services
list.short_desc: Book cleanup and accounting system completion. Monthly/quarterly/annual tax filing and financial statement preparation. Chief Accountant secondment and financial supervision services.
list.full_content:
Service Details

The accounting department plays a pivotal role in providing accurate and timely financial information to the Board of Directors.

  • Cleanup of historical accounting data and completion of books and vouchers
  • Monthly, quarterly, and annual tax filing and finalization (VAT, CIT, PIT)
  • Preparation of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements per standards
  • Consulting on building accounting information systems, books, and posting processes
  • Professional Chief Accountant secondment service
  • Monthly financial accounting supervision
  • Explanation of figures to tax authorities and auditors

list.title: HR, Payroll & Social Insurance
list.short_desc: Supply of highly skilled personnel, HR management consulting, full payroll processing & social insurance (SI, HI, UI) administration. Training for accounting staff and labor regulation drafting.
list.full_content:
Service Details

Helping businesses focus on core strategies without worrying about HR and insurance matters.

  • Supply of specialized personnel (accountants, technicians, interpreters, managers...)
  • Consulting on drafting labor regulations, employment contracts, and salary scales
  • Full payroll processing and monthly SI/HI/UI contribution management
  • First-time SI registration, SI book management, and handling of sick leave/maternity benefits
  • Accounting staff training programs for enterprises
  • Support in building corporate culture and performance evaluation

list.title: Business Management Consulting
list.short_desc: Design of internal control systems, cash flow management, inventory control. Corporate restructuring advice, charter development, and corporate governance for joint stock companies.
list.full_content:
Service Details

We aim to help clients continuously improve and enhance the efficiency of their production and business operations.

  • Design of internal control systems tailored to business needs
  • Cash flow management consulting and design of reporting/control templates
  • Inventory control system development, loss norms, and cost calculation
  • Corporate structure consulting and optimal restructuring
  • Development of company charter, Board of Directors regulations, and Supervisory Board rules
  • AGM organization consulting and professional shareholder register management
  • Customized training on governance topics

list.title: Foreign Investment Consulting (FDI)
list.short_desc: Establishment of 100% foreign-owned companies, representative offices, and joint ventures. Investment project planning, project management, project transfer, and ongoing legal counsel for FDI enterprises.
list.full_content:
Key Service Areas

• 100% Foreign-Owned Company Formation

Investment registration procedures, Investment Certificates under the 2020 Investment Law, and related licensing.

• Representative Offices & Foreign Contractors

Establishment of representative offices and foreign contractor permits in construction and consulting sectors.

• Joint Ventures & Investment Projects

Joint venture structures, joint venture agreements, and feasibility study preparation.

• Ongoing Legal Counsel for FDI

Corporate governance, contracts, IP, labor, tax compliance, and periodic reporting support.

ETAX Ho Chi Minh is a reputable foreign investment advisory firm with strong FDI expertise and a professional process from initial meeting to final handover.

list.title: Financial & M&A - Restructuring Services
list.short_desc: M&A advisory, financial restructuring, corporate type conversion (LLC ↔ JSC), equitization, and divestment support.
list.full_content:
Service Details

Supporting businesses in strategic transactions and restructuring to optimize value and operational efficiency.

  • M&A strategy development, target search and selection
  • Business valuation and fair pricing advisory
  • M&A transaction structure advice and negotiation support
  • Financial due diligence and restructuring plan development
  • Corporate type conversion advisory (LLC to JSC and vice versa)
  • State-owned enterprise equitization and divestment consulting
  • Financial risk management (interest rates, exchange rates, stock prices)

list.title: Enterprise Management Software Solutions
list.short_desc: Advisory on selection and implementation of accounting, inventory, sales, and HR software. Installation, training, maintenance, and customization services.
list.full_content:
Service Details

Information technology creates new opportunities to improve operational efficiency. We help businesses choose and apply the most suitable software solutions.

  • Needs assessment and analysis of pros/cons of popular software options
  • Advisory on the most suitable accounting, warehouse, sales, and HR software
  • Demo, installation, implementation planning, and detailed user training
  • Customization of software to meet specific business requirements
  • Handover, acceptance, and periodic maintenance packages
  • Ongoing support for accounting entries and internal controls

Popular solutions trusted by our clients: Online Accounting Software, Warehouse & Sales Management Software, HR Management Software.

careers.title: Career Opportunities
careers.intro: ETAX Ho Chi Minh is always looking for talented, passionate, and responsible individuals to join our professional, dynamic, and sustainable growth environment. We believe people are the key factor that makes the difference.

openings.title: Tax & Accounting Advisory Specialist (Senior/Junior)
openings.desc: Provide tax policy consulting, support filing and finalization, review legitimate expenses for FDI clients. Requirements: Bachelor's in Accounting/Tax, professional certificate or 2-5 years experience.

openings.title: Lawyer / Foreign Investment Advisory Specialist
openings.desc: Advise on 100% foreign-owned company formation, representative offices, investment licenses, and joint venture agreements. Requirements: Law degree, FDI experience or practicing lawyer certificate.

openings.title: Chief Accountant (Secondment)
openings.desc: Act as Chief Accountant for multiple clients. Prepare financial statements, sign documents, advise on financial risks. Requirements: Chief Accountant certificate, 5+ years experience.

openings.title: Project Assistant & HR Admin
openings.desc: Support project implementation, prepare dossiers, liaise with government agencies, manage internal HR. Requirements: Degree in Economics/Law/Public Administration, good English, careful and agile.

benefits: Professional, transparent, and respectful work environment
Direct learning opportunities from lawyers, chief accountants, and experts with 15+ years experience
Competitive salary package, project bonuses, and year-end bonuses
Regular internal training + support for professional certifications
Full social, health, and unemployment insurance as per law
Annual leave, public holidays + yearly team building trips
